events.title: A Ruud van Nistelrooy hat-trick contributes to 맨체스터 유나이티드's 4–1 home win over 찰턴 애슬레틱 and puts them on the brink of title glory.

아스널 lose 3–2 at home to 리즈 유나이티드 , a result which ensures 리즈 유나이티드's safety and ends 아스널's defence of the title. 맨체스터 유나이티드 are crowned league champions for the eighth time in 11 seasons. 선덜랜드 are relegated from the Premier League with a record low of 4 wins, 19 points and 21 goals. 슈루즈버리 타운 are relegated to the Conference , ending 53 years of Football League membership. 엑서터 시티 finished 23rd in Division Three and are also relegated to the Conference – the first club to suffer automatic relegation without finishing bottom of the league. 페테르 슈마이켈 calls time on his footballing career six months before his 40th birthday after helping 맨체스터 시티 to finish ninth in the Premiership.
더비 카운티 confirm that suspended manager John Gregory will not be returning, and his contract is terminated to make way for George Burley to receive the job on a permanent basis.

웨스트햄 유나이티드 are relegated after 10 years in the Premier League after failing to get the better of a Birmingham side who hold them to a 2–2 draw. Bolton are safe after a 2–1 home win over 미들즈브러. 선덜랜드's 4–0 home defeat to 아스널 sees them end the season as officially the worst Premier League team ever with a record low of four wins, 19 points and 21 goals. Not since 스토크 시티 in the old First Division 18 years ago has any top flight club attained such a poor record in the top flight. Ninth-placed 맨체스터 시티 bid farewell to Maine Road after 80 years, their last game before relocation to the City of Manchester Stadium being watched by a 35,000 capacity crowd as they lost 1–0 to eighth placed 사우샘프턴. The final goal at the stadium is scored by Saints defender Michael Svensson .
아스널 ease their Premier League disappointment by winning the FA Cup for the ninth time in their history, beating 사우샘프턴 1–0 at the Millennium Stadium courtesy of a first-half Robert Pires goal.
에버턴 sign 조지프 요보 from 마르세유 for £3.5million.
카디프 시티 F.C. defeat 퀸스 파크 레인저스 F.C. in the Football League Second Division play-off final held at The Millennium Stadium in Cardiff , Wales .
울버햄프턴 원더러스 return to the top flight after a 19-year exile by beating 셰필드 유나이티드 3–0 in the Division One play-off final.
A.C. AC 밀란 win the 2002/2003 final of the UEFA Champions League by beating 유벤투스 3:2 ( penalty shootout) at Old Trafford in Manchester . The game had ended 0–0 before the shootout.
